# Every file this fork changes against upstream's main. .github/scripts/check-fork-allowlist.sh
# fails on a changed file not listed here, and on a line the fork no longer changes. A line ending
# in / is a directory the fork owns, where upstream has no file. Add a file here in the same change
# that first edits it. When the daily sync pull request fails on a line the fork no longer changes,
# because upstream took the change, remove the line with a commit on the sync branch.

# The fork's own web app, beside upstream's, outside the root workspaces.
packages/tl-dispatch/

# The fork's UI package, outside the root workspaces, and the shadcn registry that serves it.
packages/ui/
registry.json

# The fork's checks.
.github/fork-allowlist.txt
.github/scripts/check-fork-allowlist.sh
.github/scripts/check-fork-allowlist.test.sh
.github/workflows/fork-checks.yaml

# The daily sync from upstream.
.github/scripts/fork-sync.sh
.github/scripts/fork-sync.test.sh
.github/workflows/fork-sync.yaml
.github/workflows/fork-sync-test.yaml
.github/scripts/check-image-trigger-paths.sh

# The fork's own image line: no upstream release numbers.
.github/workflows/fork-worker-image.yaml
.github/workflows/release-envoy-listener.yaml

# The leak scan masks links to the pull request's own repository, which on a fork is not upstream's.
.github/scripts/check-pr-text.sh
.github/scripts/check-private-names-test-lib.sh
.github/scripts/check-private-names.test.sh

# A fix not yet upstream.
packages/daemon/internal/ghbranch/ghbranch.go
packages/daemon/internal/ghbranch/ghbranch_test.go

# The docs build names the repository the fork was forked from.
.github/scripts/ci_filter_coverage.py
.github/workflows/docs-site.yaml
